svg.title: Compilation energy payback horizons and name-free reuse soundness
svg.desc: Left: log-log lifecycle energy E_compile + N * E_run (RAPL core reported_j) across six compiler tiers over N = 1 to 10^8 kernel invocations, showing empirical crossover horizons N*. Right top: -O2 to -O3 payback outcomes across 20 kernels. Right bottom: E5-Scale soundness across 500 verified semantic mutants comparing De Bruijn nameless hashes (0% false hits) against naive identifier-stripping (100% collision on 150 variable-binding swaps).
